name: cbb_v1_frozen_spec_v1
status: CANDIDATE - binding only after publisher commits and adversarial checks pass

feature_formulas.features: home team rolling value minus away team rolling value; home_ind 0 at neutral site else 1

point_in_time_rules: same-date atomic: a game never consumes a same-day result
priors: immediately preceding completed season only, keyed by stable teamId
coefficients, scaler, sigma, Platt a/b: fit-window rows only
d1_rule: season-specific: team carries non-null non-zero conference_id in that season's schedule (ESPN conference 43 = independents, correctly D1); --d1-only excludes games involving any non-D1 team
availability_rule: strictly-earlier-calendar-date only; bulk assets are retro snapshots, not contemporaneous; retro corrections upstream are an acknowledged open provenance caveat

protected_set.enforcement: files undeclared in manifest rejected unread; protected rows abort the run; --unlock-final-test always refuses in this trainer
